create.sql:
CREATE TABLE `import_executions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `batch_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `operation_key` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `request_hash` binary(32) NOT NULL,
  `command_json` json NOT NULL,
  `progress_json` json NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `lease_token` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
  `lease_until` datetime(3) NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_import_execution_operation` (`batch_id`,`actor_id`,`operation_key`),
  KEY `ix_import_execution_actor` (`actor_id`),
  KEY `ix_import_execution_status` (`status`,`lease_until`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_import_execution_batch_id` FOREIGN KEY (`batch_id`) REFERENCES `import_batches` (`id`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_import_execution_actor_id` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
